sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Redefining Agent Performance and Cost
sources.snippet: Today, we officially roll out MiniMax M3.1 Flash. As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.

sources.title: minimax-m3.1-flash Model by Minimaxai | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a native multimodal mixture-of-experts model for coding, agentic workflows, computer use, and cybersecurity.

sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Benchmarks, Pricing & Context Window
sources.snippet: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is the flash successor in the MiniMax M3 family, released 2026-10-19. It is a multimodal reasoning model with a 1M-token context window, native image and video input, and text output.

sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash — Fast, Low-Cost Agent Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is the general release of MiniMax's M3.1 Flash model, announced on October 19, 2026. It follows MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview, which debuted in MiniMax Code on September 28, 2026 and was limited to the M Plan subscription.

sources.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on Blackbox
sources.snippet: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is MiniMax's multimodal M-series model for agent reasoning, tool use, coding, and long-context tasks. Fireworks serves the final weights with hybrid MXFP8 and NVFP4 expert precision, text and image inputs, structured outputs, and implicit prompt caching.
